```{r, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(brms)
library(tidyverse)
library(rticulate)
library(rcartocolor)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpmisc)
library(modelbased)
library(posterior)
library(ggdist)
library(marginaleffects)
```


## Read UTI data
```{r, message=FALSE}
folder_path <- "../isochrony_data/export_isochrony_dlc"
dlc_data <- read_rds(paste0(folder_path,"/dlc_data.rds"))
unique(dlc_data |> group_by(frame_id) |> count(client))

less_than_7_frames <- c(paste(2073:2076,"en14",sep = "_"),
                        paste(3376:3422,"en18",sep = "_"))
dlc_data <- dlc_data |>
  group_by(client) |>
  mutate(displ_id = displ_id - min(displ_id)+1,
         frame_id = frame_id - min(frame_id)+1,
         displ_id_client = paste(displ_id, client, sep = "_"),
         frame_id_client = paste(frame_id, client, sep = "_")) |>
  ungroup()
dlc_data_displ <- dlc_data |>
    filter(!(frame_id_client %in% less_than_7_frames))

dates_to_filter <- dlc_data |>
  filter((client == "en14" & frame_id == 2073) | (client == "en18" & frame_id == 3376) |
           (client == "en11" & displ_id %in% c(635,2234)) | (client == "en01" & displ_id %in% c(1310,2225))) |>
  select(date_time) |>
  unique()
```

## Read data on vowels 
```{r, message=FALSE}
vowel_start_end_01 <- read_csv(paste0(folder_path,"/vowel_start_end_all_01_2.csv"))
# vowel_start_end_01 |>
#   group_by(date_time) |>
#   count(n_of_vowel) |> filter(n > 1)
# vowel_start_end_01 <- vowel_start_end_01 |>
#   mutate(date_vowel = paste(date_time, n_of_vowel, sep = "_")) |>
#   filter(!duplicated(date_vowel))
# sum(duplicated(vowel_start_end_01["date_vowel"]))

vowel_start_end_wide_01 <- vowel_start_end_01 |> 
    #select(-date_vowel) |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = n_of_vowel, 
      values_from = ends_with("_of_vowel_within_annot"),
    )
vowel_start_end_wide_01 <- vowel_start_end_wide_01 |> 
  filter(!(vowel_start_end_wide_01$date_time %in% dates_to_filter$date_time))

vowel_acoustics <- read_csv(paste0(folder_path,"/vowel_acoustic_distance_start.csv"))
vowel_acoustics_wide <- vowel_acoustics |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = n_of_vowel, 
      values_from = c(startpoint,duration),
    )
vowel_acoustics_wide <- vowel_acoustics_wide |> 
  filter(!(vowel_acoustics_wide$date_time %in% dates_to_filter$date_time))

word_segments <- read_csv("../isochrony_data/stimuli/isochrony_wlist_vowels.csv")
word_segments <- word_segments |>
  mutate(poa_C2 = case_when((C2 == "p" | C2 == "b")~"bilabial",
                            (C2 == "t" | C2 == "d")~"alveolar",
                            (C2 == "k" | C2 == "g")~"velar"),
         voice_C2 = case_when((C2 %in% c("b","d","g"))~1,
                              (C2 %in% c("p","t","k"))~0))

participants <- read_csv(paste0(folder_path,"/../participants.csv"))
participants <- participants |>
  mutate(id = paste0("en", id))

```

## sampling rate 
### almost only visual / no overwriting of data
```{r}
dlc_data_displ |>
  group_by(displ_id_client) |>
  mutate(dt = time_annot - lag(time_annot)) |>
  summarise(mean_dt = mean(dt, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  summarise(mean_fs = round(mean(1/mean_dt)))

dlc_data |>
  ggplot(aes(X, Y, colour = as.factor(knot))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(vars(client), scales = "free_y", ncol = 6)
```

## For all participants, the whole data wrangling up until landmarks
```{r}
### only tongue knots
dlc_tongue <- dlc_data_displ |> 
  filter(spline == "DLC_Tongue")

### smooth
dlc_tongue <- dlc_tongue |> 
  mutate(
    Y_sm = filter_signal(Y, order = 2, window_length = 7, apply = 2),
    .by = displ_id_client
  )

### resample
dlc_tongue_up <- dlc_tongue |> 
  reframe(
    resample_signal(Y_sm, time_annot, by = 3),
    .by = displ_id_client
  )

### join back other variables
dlc_tongue_up <- dlc_tongue_up |> 
  left_join(y = dlc_tongue |> select(client, date_time, Prompt, spline, knot, displ_id, word, displ_id_client) |> distinct()) |> 
  rename(Y_sm_up = signal_int)

### smooth
dlc_tongue_up <- dlc_tongue_up |> 
  mutate(
    Y_sm_up_sm = filter_signal(Y_sm_up, order = 2, window_length = 7, apply = 2),
    .by = displ_id_client
  )

### join vowel interval info
dlc_tongue_up <- left_join(dlc_tongue_up |> select(-c(Prompt, spline)) |> distinct(), vowel_start_end_wide_01 |> select(-stimulus) |> distinct(), by = join_by(date_time))

no_V1 <- dlc_tongue_up |>
  filter(is.na(start_of_vowel_within_annot_1)) |>
  select(date_time,word,file,client) |>
  unique()
no_V2 <- dlc_tongue_up |>
  filter(is.na(start_of_vowel_within_annot_2)) |>
  select(date_time,word,file,client) |>
  unique()

dlc_tongue_up <- dlc_tongue_up |>
  filter(!(date_time %in% no_V1$date_time | date_time %in% no_V2$date_time))

dlc_tongue_up <- dlc_tongue_up |>
  mutate(across(
    .cols = c(start_of_vowel_within_annot_1,end_of_vowel_within_annot_1,start_of_vowel_within_annot_2,end_of_vowel_within_annot_2), round, 2,
    .names = "{.col}_round"
    )
  ) |>
  rename(
    start1_round = start_of_vowel_within_annot_1_round,
    end1_round = end_of_vowel_within_annot_1_round,
    start2_round = start_of_vowel_within_annot_2_round,
    end2_round = end_of_vowel_within_annot_2_round
  )

### calculate velocity signal
dlc_tongue_up <- dlc_tongue_up |> 
  mutate(
    Y_sm_up_vel = get_velocity(Y_sm_up_sm)
  ) |>
  relocate(c(Y_sm_up_vel,Y_sm_up_sm), .before = Y_sm_up) |>
  relocate(c(file,word), .after = date_time)
```

### Overview functions for landmarks
```{r}
landmarks_segmentinfo <- function(lands, tongue_up) {left_join(lands, dlc_tongue_up |> select(displ_id_client,word,client,date_time,file,displ_id,start1_round,end1_round,start2_round,end2_round) |> distinct(), by = join_by(displ_id_client)) |> 
  relocate(c(word,file,start1_round,end1_round,start2_round,end2_round), .after = displ_id_client) |>
  left_join(y = word_segments, by = join_by(word)) |>
  relocate(stress, .after = word) |>
  arrange(group,stress,V2,poa_C2,voice_C2,R,word)
}
poa_na_summary <- function(landmarks_segmentinfo,both = 1,var1,var2) {
  landmarks_segmentinfo |>
    filter(group == 1) |>
    group_by({{var1}}, {{var2}}) |>
    summarise_at(ifelse(both == 1, 
                        c("max_disp_time_1","max_disp_time_2","max_disp_distance"),
                        "max_disp_time"),~sum(is.na(.)))
}
```

## Get landmarks for the whole dataset (1-23)
### V1
```{r,message=FALSE}
#write_csv(dlc_tongue_up, "../isochrony_data/export_isochrony_dlc/dlc_tongue_up.csv")
dlc_tongue_up <- read_csv("../isochrony_data/export_isochrony_dlc/dlc_tongue_up.csv")

dlc_up_lands_1_8 <- dlc_tongue_up |> 
    filter(knot == 8, time_int > start_of_vowel_within_annot_1-0.03, 
           time_int < end_of_vowel_within_annot_1+0.03) |> 
    reframe(
      get_landmarks(Y_sm_up_vel, time_int, start_of_vowel_within_annot_1-0.03, end_of_vowel_within_annot_1+0.03),
      .by = displ_id_client
    )

dlc_tongue_up |> 
    filter(knot == 10, time_int > start_of_vowel_within_annot_1, 
           time_int < end_of_vowel_within_annot_1, client == "en10" , word == "aggadic") |>
    reframe(
      max_disp <- get_zerocross(Y_sm_up_vel, time_int, start = start_of_vowel_within_annot_1, end = end_of_vowel_within_annot_1),
      .by = displ_id_client
    )

dlc_up_lands_segmentinfo_1_8 <- landmarks_segmentinfo(dlc_up_lands_1_8, dlc_tongue_up)
poa_na_summary(dlc_up_lands_segmentinfo_1_8,0,client,poa_C2)
```

### V2
```{r}
dlc_up_lands_2_8 <- dlc_tongue_up |> 
    filter(knot == 8, time_int > end_of_vowel_within_annot_1, 
           time_int < end_of_vowel_within_annot_2+0.03) |> 
    reframe(
      get_landmarks(Y_sm_up_vel, time_int, end_of_vowel_within_annot_1, end_of_vowel_within_annot_2+0.03),
      .by = displ_id_client
    )

dlc_up_lands_segmentinfo_2_8 <- landmarks_segmentinfo(dlc_up_lands_2_8, dlc_tongue_up)
poa_na_summary(dlc_up_lands_segmentinfo_2_8,0,client,poa_C2)
```

### Join landmarks for V1 and V2 
```{r}
dlc_landmarks_full <- add_row(dlc_up_lands_segmentinfo_1_8 |>
                                mutate(vowel_number = 1),
                              dlc_up_lands_segmentinfo_2_8 |>
                                mutate(vowel_number = 2))
dlc_landmarks_full_wide <- dlc_landmarks_full |>
  rename(date = date_time) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = vowel_number,
    values_from = 9:22
    #ends_with("_time"|"_vel"|"_on"|"_off")
  )
dlc_landmarks_full_wide_8 <- dlc_landmarks_full_wide |>
  mutate(max_disp_distance = max_disp_time_2 - max_disp_time_1)
#write_csv(dlc_landmarks_full_wide,"../isochrony_data/export_isochrony_dlc/dlc_landmarks.csv")
dlc_landmarks_full_wide <- read_csv("../isochrony_data/export_isochrony_dlc/dlc_landmarks.csv")

#poa_na_summary(dlc_landmarks_full_wide,1,client,poa_C2)
a8 <- dlc_landmarks_full_wide_8 |>
  filter(group == 1 & poa_C2 != "bilabial") |>
  group_by(client) |>
  summarise_at(c("max_disp_time_1","max_disp_time_2","max_disp_distance"),~sum(is.na(.))) |>
    left_join(y = dlc_landmarks_full_wide |>
      filter(group == 1 & poa_C2 != "bilabial") |>
      group_by(client) |>
      tally(), by = join_by(client))
left_join(a10, a8, by = join_by(client))
```

### Number of tokens per word (out of max.40)
```{r}
dlc_landmarks_full_wide <- dlc_landmarks_full_wide |>
  mutate(GEST_ons_distance = GEST_ons_2 - GEST_ons_1,
         peak_1_vel_distance = peak_1_time_2 - peak_1_time_1,
         peak_2_vel_distance = peak_2_time_2 - peak_2_time_1,
         stress_group = paste(stress,V1,V2,sep = "_"),
         across_within = case_when(
           (stress == "1020" | stress == "200")~"within",
           (stress == "020" | stress == "0200")~"across"
         ),
         R = ifelse(R == 1, "Cr","C"),
         voice_C2 = ifelse(voice_C2 == 1, "voiced","voiceless")) |>
  relocate(.after = file) |>
  filter(group == 1, client != "en21", poa_C2 != "bilabial") |>
  left_join(y = participants |> select(id, dialect), by = join_by(client == id))

dlc_landmarks_full_wide |> 
  group_by(is.na(max_disp_distance),group) |>
  count(word) |>
  arrange(group,n)

dlc_landmarks_full_wide |>
  filter(is.na(max_disp_distance), client == "en10") |>
  arrange(client)
```

### Statistics
```{r}
mdd_bm_5 <- brm(
  max_disp_distance ~ across_within*R*voice_C2 + poa_C2 + (across_within:R:voice_C2 | client),
  family = lognormal,
  data = dlc_landmarks_full_wide |> drop_na(max_disp_distance),
  seed = 1852,
  file = "cache/mdd_bm_5"
)
summary(mdd_bm_5)

god_bm_5 <- brm(
  GEST_ons_distance ~ across_within*R*voice_C2 + poa_C2 + (across_within:R:voice_C2 | client),
```

### Acoustics
```{r}
acoustics_groups <- inner_join(vowel_acoustics_wide,dlc_landmarks_full_wide |> select(date,word,displ_id_client,dialect), by = join_by(date_time == date)) |>
  left_join(y = word_segments, by = join_by(word)) |>
  mutate(V_distance = startpoint_2 - startpoint_1,
           stress_group = paste(stress,V1,V2,sep = "_"),
         across_within = case_when(
           (stress == "1020" | stress == "200")~"within",
           (stress == "020" | stress == "0200")~"across"
         ),
         R = ifelse(R == 1, "Cr","C"),
         voice_C2 = ifelse(voice_C2 == 1, "voiced","voiceless")) |>
  filter(group == 1, participant != "en21", poa_C2 != "bilabial")

ad_bm_5 <- brm(
  V_distance ~ across_within*R*voice_C2 + poa_C2 + (across_within*R*voice_C2 | participant),
  family = lognormal,
  data = acoustics_groups,
  seed = 1852,
  cores = 4,
  file = "cache/ad_bm_5"
)
summary(ad_bm_5)

get_prior(V_distance ~ across_within*R*voice_C2 + V2 + poa_C2 + (across_within*R*voice_C2 | participant),
  family = lognormal,
  data = acoustics_groups)

acoustics_groups |>
  ggplot(aes(x = V_distance, colour = as_factor(voice_C2))) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~stress_group)
```

```{r}
draws <- as_draws_df(ad_bm_4)

draws_pred_across_R_09 <- draws |>
  mutate(
    C_across = exp(b_Intercept + `r_participant[en09,Intercept]`),
    C_across_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + `r_participant[en09,Intercept]`+`b_voice_C2voiceless` +`r_participant[en09,voice_C2voiceless]`),
    Cr_across = exp(b_Intercept + `r_participant[en09,Intercept]`+ b_RCr + `r_participant[en09,RCr]`),
    Cr_across_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + `r_participant[en09,Intercept]`+ b_RCr + `r_participant[en09,RCr]` + `b_voice_C2voiceless`+`r_participant[en09,voice_C2voiceless]` + `b_RCr:voice_C2voiceless` + `r_participant[en09,RCr:voice_C2voiceless]`),
    C_within = exp(b_Intercept + `r_participant[en09,Intercept]`+ `b_across_withinwithin`+ `r_participant[en09,across_withinwithin]`),
    C_within_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + `r_participant[en09,Intercept]`+ `b_across_withinwithin`+ `r_participant[en09,across_withinwithin]` + `b_voice_C2voiceless`+`r_participant[en09,voice_C2voiceless]` + `b_across_withinwithin:voice_C2voiceless`+ `r_participant[en09,across_withinwithin:voice_C2voiceless]`),
    Cr_within = exp(b_Intercept + `r_participant[en09,Intercept]`+ `b_across_withinwithin`+ `r_participant[en09,across_withinwithin]` + b_RCr + `r_participant[en09,RCr]`+ `b_across_withinwithin:RCr`+ `r_participant[en09,across_withinwithin:RCr]`),
    Cr_within_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + `r_participant[en09,Intercept]`+ `b_across_withinwithin`+ `r_participant[en09,across_withinwithin]` + b_RCr + `r_participant[en09,RCr]`+ `b_voice_C2voiceless`+`r_participant[en09,voice_C2voiceless]` + `b_RCr:voice_C2voiceless`+ `r_participant[en09,RCr:voice_C2voiceless]`+ `b_across_withinwithin:voice_C2voiceless`+ `r_participant[en09,across_withinwithin:voice_C2voiceless]`+ `b_across_withinwithin:RCr` +`r_participant[en09,across_withinwithin:RCr]`+`b_across_withinwithin:RCr:voice_C2voiceless`+ `r_participant[en09,across_withinwithin:RCr:voice_C2voiceless]`)
    )
draws_long_across_R_09 <- draws_pred_across_R_09 |> 
  select(.chain, .iteration, .draw, starts_with("C")) |> 
  pivot_longer(C_across:Cr_within_Vless, names_to = "aw_RCr_voice", values_to = "pred") |>
  mutate(across = ifelse(aw_RCr_voice %in% c("C_across","Cr_across","C_across_Vless","Cr_across_Vless"),"across","within"),
         R = ifelse(aw_RCr_voice %in% c("C_across","C_within","C_across_Vless","C_within_Vless"),"C","Cr"),
         voice = ifelse(aw_RCr_voice %in% c("C_across","Cr_across","C_within","Cr_within"),"voiced","voiceless"))

draws_long_across_R_09 |> 
  ggplot(aes(pred, R, fill = R)) +
  stat_halfeye() +
  labs(x = "Predicted distance between first and second vowel", y = "cluster?") + 
  facet_grid(vars(voice),vars(across)) +
  xlim(0.1,0.4) +
  guides(position = NULL)
```

```{r}
post_dist_from_bm <- function(bm) {
  draws <- as_draws_df(bm)

  draws_pred_across_R <- draws |>
    mutate(
      C_across = exp(b_Intercept),
      C_across_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + `b_voice_C2voiceless`),
      Cr_across = exp(b_Intercept + b_RCr),
      Cr_across_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + b_RCr + `b_voice_C2voiceless` + `b_RCr:voice_C2voiceless`),
      C_within = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin`),
      C_within_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin` + `b_voice_C2voiceless` + `b_across_withinwithin:voice_C2voiceless`),
      Cr_within = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin` + b_RCr + `b_across_withinwithin:RCr`),
      Cr_within_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin` + b_RCr + `b_voice_C2voiceless` + `b_RCr:voice_C2voiceless` + `b_across_withinwithin:voice_C2voiceless` + `b_across_withinwithin:RCr` + `b_across_withinwithin:RCr:voice_C2voiceless`)
      )
  draws_long_across_R <- draws_pred_across_R |> 
    select(.chain, .iteration, .draw, starts_with("C")) |> 
    pivot_longer(C_across:Cr_within_Vless, names_to = "aw_RCr_voice", values_to = "pred") |>
    mutate(across = ifelse(aw_RCr_voice %in% c("C_across","Cr_across","C_across_Vless","Cr_across_Vless"),"across","within"),
           R = ifelse(aw_RCr_voice %in% c("C_across","C_within","C_across_Vless","C_within_Vless"),"C","Cr"),
           voice = ifelse(aw_RCr_voice %in% c("C_across","Cr_across","C_within","Cr_within"),"voiced","voiceless"))
  
  draws_long_across_R |> 
    ggplot(aes(pred, R, fill = R)) +
    stat_halfeye() +
    labs(x = "Predicted distance between first and second vowel", y = "cluster?") + 
    facet_grid(vars(voice),vars(across)) +
    xlim(0.1,0.4) +
    guides(position = NULL)
}
post_dist_from_bm(ad_bm_4)
post_dist_from_bm(god_bm_4)
post_dist_from_bm(p1vd_bm_4)
post_dist_from_bm(mdd_bm_4)
```

```{r}
post_dist_from_bm <- function(bm) {
  draws <- as_draws_df(bm)

  draws_pred_across_R <- draws |>
    mutate(
      C_across = exp(b_Intercept),
      C_across_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + `b_voice_C2voiceless`),
      Cr_across = exp(b_Intercept + b_RCr),
      Cr_across_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + b_RCr + `b_voice_C2voiceless` + `b_RCr:voice_C2voiceless`),
      C_within = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin`),
      C_within_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin` + `b_voice_C2voiceless` + `b_across_withinwithin:voice_C2voiceless`),
      Cr_within = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin` + b_RCr + `b_across_withinwithin:RCr`),
      Cr_within_Vless = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin` + b_RCr + `b_voice_C2voiceless` + `b_RCr:voice_C2voiceless` + `b_across_withinwithin:voice_C2voiceless` + `b_across_withinwithin:RCr` + `b_across_withinwithin:RCr:voice_C2voiceless`),
      
      C_across_velar = exp(b_Intercept + `b_poa_C2velar`),
      C_across_Vless_velar = exp(b_Intercept + `b_voice_C2voiceless` + `b_poa_C2velar`),
      Cr_across_velar = exp(b_Intercept + b_RCr + `b_poa_C2velar`),
      Cr_across_Vless_velar = exp(b_Intercept + b_RCr + `b_voice_C2voiceless` + `b_RCr:voice_C2voiceless` + `b_poa_C2velar`),
      C_within_velar = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin` + `b_poa_C2velar`),
      C_within_Vless_velar = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin` + `b_voice_C2voiceless` + `b_across_withinwithin:voice_C2voiceless` + `b_poa_C2velar`),
      Cr_within_velar = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin` + b_RCr + `b_across_withinwithin:RCr` + `b_poa_C2velar`),
      Cr_within_Vless_velar = exp(b_Intercept + `b_across_withinwithin` + b_RCr + `b_voice_C2voiceless` + `b_RCr:voice_C2voiceless` + `b_across_withinwithin:voice_C2voiceless` + `b_across_withinwithin:RCr` + `b_across_withinwithin:RCr:voice_C2voiceless` + `b_poa_C2velar`),
      )
  draws_long_across_R <- draws_pred_across_R |> 
    select(.chain, .iteration, .draw, starts_with("C")) |> 
    pivot_longer(C_across:Cr_within_Vless_velar, names_to = "aw_RCr_voice", values_to = "pred") |>
    mutate(across = ifelse(aw_RCr_voice %in% c("C_across","Cr_across","C_across_Vless","Cr_across_Vless",
                           "C_across_velar","Cr_across_velar","C_across_Vless_velar","Cr_across_Vless_velar"),
                           "across","within"),
           R = ifelse(aw_RCr_voice %in% c("C_across","C_within","C_across_Vless","C_within_Vless",
                                          "C_across_velar","C_within_velar","C_across_Vless_velar","C_within_Vless_velar"),
                            "C","Cr"),
           voice = ifelse(aw_RCr_voice %in% c("C_across","Cr_across","C_within","Cr_within",
                                              "C_across_velar","Cr_across_velar","C_within_velar","Cr_within_velar"),
                            "voiced","voiceless"),
           poa_C2 = ifelse(aw_RCr_voice %in% c("C_across","C_within","Cr_across","Cr_within",
                                               "C_across_Vless","C_within_Vless","Cr_across_Vless","Cr_within_Vless"),
                            "alveolar","velar")
          )
  draws_long_across_R |> 
    ggplot(aes(pred, voice, fill = voice)) +
    stat_halfeye() +
    labs(x = "Predicted distance between first and second vowel", y = "cluster?") + 
    facet_grid(vars(R),vars(across)) +
    xlim(0.1,0.4) +
    guides(position = NULL)
}
```
